newsitem.title: BURKINA FASO: Burkina president shuffles cabinet after election.
newsitem.headline: Burkina president shuffles cabinet after election.

text.p: Burkina Faso's President Blaise Compaore has shuffled his cabinet following his party's win in May 11 general elections, an official statement said.

The new cabinet, proposed by Prime Minister Kadre Desire Ouedraogo, appoints Albert Millogo as defence minister to replace Colonel Badaye Fayama, and retires Hermann Yameogo as minister of state for solidarity and African integration.
The cabinet announced on Tuesday evening has six new ministers, one new minister of state and two new deputy ministers.
It is made up entirely of members or supporters of Compaore's ruling Congress for Democracy and Progress (CDP), which won 97 of the new assembly's 111 seats in the election.
The finance, foreign affairs and mines ministers remain the same.
